name: Carmen
beschreibung: The Ferienhaus Carmen is located on a quiet side street in the municipality of [Ortsname] in Tirol. The surroundings are dominated by meadows and woodland areas, which invite you to go hiking in summer. The house has a fully equipped kitchen with an electric stove and refrigerator, as well as a separate living room. The furnishings are traditional and use a lot of wood, which creates a warm atmosphere. Overall, the atmosphere is quiet and rural. This makes the house particularly suitable for couples or families looking for a quiet holiday base in the Alps.
